blocks.x: U.S. Army Soldiers assigned to the 21st Theater Sustainment Command exercise during the Spellacy Special Physical Training Session in the Spellacy Fitness Center, on Panzer Kaserne, Kaiserslautern, Germany, June 23, 2026.
